feed.subtitle: Plain-language marketing guides for local businesses in Kalyan, Dombivli and Thane

entry.title: How to set up a Google Business Profile for a shop in Kalyan
entry.summary: Search for your business on Google Maps, claim it or add it, choose the right categories, add your real address or service area, timings, phone number and photos, then complete Google's verification. Keep the name, address and phone identical everywhere online. Free, and the base of every local marketing plan.

entry.title: How much should a local shop spend on Instagram and Facebook ads?
entry.summary: Work backwards from the customers you want. Divide the customers you need by the share of enquiries you usually close to get the enquiries you need, then multiply by what one enquiry costs. Start with a small test, read the real cost per enquiry, and then decide. We suggest ₹8,000 to 15,000 a month for one shop.

entry.title: Google Maps or Instagram first? Where to put your first ₹10,000
entry.summary: If customers search when they need you, such as for a dentist, mechanic or pharmacy, start with Google Maps. If they buy by look or mood, such as for a salon, boutique, café or gym, start with Instagram. Many shops do best with a complete Google profile first, because it needs no ad spend.

entry.title: How to get more Google reviews without breaking Google's rules
entry.summary: Ask every happy customer, right after good service, with a QR card at the counter and a short WhatsApp message that links straight to your review page. Do not offer gifts or discounts in exchange for reviews, do not ask only happy customers to review, and never buy or write reviews yourself.

entry.title: A simple WhatsApp reply system that stops you losing enquiries
entry.summary: Use WhatsApp Business with a greeting message, a handful of quick replies and labels for each enquiry's status. Aim to answer within 15 minutes in working hours, write down who replies when, and follow up once the next day. Speed and a clear next step win local customers.

entry.title: Meta lead form ads or click-to-WhatsApp ads: which should you use?
entry.summary: Use lead form ads when you want a name and phone number you can call back, and your team can call quickly. Use click-to-WhatsApp ads when customers prefer to chat first and you can reply fast. Many local businesses start with WhatsApp because it feels natural, then add forms for higher-value offers.

entry.title: Marathi, Hindi or English: which language should your ads use?
entry.summary: Use the language your customers speak when they decide. In much of Kalyan and Dombivli that is often Marathi, Hindi works across the belt, and English suits professional services and younger audiences. Do not guess: run the same offer in two languages, and let your own enquiries pick the winner.

entry.title: A local SEO checklist for shops, clinics and classes
entry.summary: Claim and complete your Google Business Profile, keep your name, address and phone identical everywhere, add real photos, collect genuine reviews, give your website a clear page for each service and area, and add fresh updates monthly. Local search rewards completeness, consistency and real activity, not tricks.

entry.title: How to read a monthly marketing report, in plain words
entry.summary: A useful report shows how much you spent, how many real enquiries it brought, what each cost, how many calls and direction requests came from Google, what worked, what did not, and what will change next month. If a report is full of impressions and followers but no enquiries, ask for the enquiries first.
